title: Chris Bledsoe flies a craft down the Cape Fear River

tellings.quote: And he said, "Suddenly the window opened and there was a Capefare River."

plain: In 2007 a man named Chris Bledsoe is said to have found himself flying a craft down the Cape Fear River in North Carolina. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron passes on what Bledsoe told him, quoting him: "Suddenly the window opened and there was a Cape Fear River." If true, it would mean Bledsoe was not only watching a craft but was somehow on board one.
